ticket.title: Total Hours is displayed inconsistently in Month View

scope: Attendance > My attendance: in Month view the Scheduled/Total/Absence hours toolbar must aggregate the whole displayed month and stay stable (no 0 vs 55 flip) regardless of week anchor or navigation. Read-only; no data is written. Role: xiontechs account only.

cases.title: Month view June 2026 shows a month-wide Total hours figure
cases.preconditions: Account has attendance data in June 2026
cases.notes: Total hours 0 in June for this account: weak evidence for the original 55 value.

steps.action: Open Attendance > My attendance, switch Week view to Month view, go to June 2026
steps.expected: Toolbar shows Scheduled/Total/Absence hours for June 2026, not the week-only values
steps.actual: Month view, June 2026: Scheduled hours: 160 / Total hours: 0 / Absence hours: 160 (month-wide values; week view showed Scheduled 40 for 5-11 Oct)

cases.title: Total hours stays the same after navigating away and back and after switching views

steps.action: From June 2026 month view go to next month then back to June 2026
steps.expected: Total hours equals the TC01 value (no 0 vs 55 flip)
steps.actual: Next month: July 2026 Scheduled hours: 184, Total hours: 0. Back to June 2026: Scheduled hours: 160, Total hours: 0, Absence hours: 160 (same as first visit)

steps.action: Switch to Week view then back to Month view (June 2026)
steps.expected: Total hours equals the TC01 value
steps.actual: Week view (1 - 7 Jun): Scheduled hours: 40, Total hours: 0. Back to Month view June 2026: Scheduled hours: 160, Total hours: 0, Absence hours: 160

cases.title: Month figure does not depend on the week anchor

steps.action: Open Week view on a different June week (e.g. 1-7 Jun), then switch to Month view
steps.expected: Month view shows the same June 2026 Total hours as TC01
steps.actual: Week view anchored 1 - 7 Jun showed Scheduled hours: 40; Month view June 2026 then showed Scheduled hours: 160, Total hours: 0, identical to the first visit

observations: This account has no attendance in June 2026 (Total hours 0, Absence 160), so the reported 0-vs-55 flip could not be reproduced with real data; checks show the Scheduled/Absence figures are month-wide and stable. A matching-data account is needed to prove Total hours = 55.
Signed-in employee profile on dev shows as Amol R Bhangale, not the danh.nguyen account name; launch-role reported the expected account.
